title: Zesty Argentinian Broccoli Stir-fry
description: A spicy and comforting flexitarian dish featuring tender broccoli, a bright lime-ginger sauce, and a hint of Argentinian red wine deglaze for depth of flavor.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and red pepper flakes, sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add broccoli florets and stir for 2 minutes until they begin to soften.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and soy sauce, then stir to coat the broccoli.
Deglaze the pan with 2 tbsp of dry red wine, scraping up any browned bits.
Add lime juice and stir to combine, letting the sauce reduce slightly.
Season with salt and black pepper and adjust to taste.
If using tofu, fold it into the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and serve hot, optionally garnished with fresh parsley or grated Parmesan.
Enjoy a quick, zesty dinner that satisfies both vegetarians and flexitarians.
